artifact_schema.description: The discrete logarithm k, as 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

k.description: k with k*G = Q, in [1, n), zero-padded to exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

statement: Find the discrete logarithm k for the NIST P-256 curve: k*G = Q. The checker pins the NIST SP 800-186 domain parameters and derives Q by trying x-coordinates from SHAKE256(seed || counter), selecting the first curve point and choosing its y parity from the digest. The seed is cairn/nist-prime-curve-dlog/p256/v1. This deterministic construction does not choose k. Submit k in [1,n), as exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits. The order n is prime and the curve cofactor is 1, so the answer is unique in this range. The derived target is Q=(83395d3abaed1ac2ecd18416e5a6cf1fb7c837347c024d6c490edec8a5e9cd5a, 22986b7bb5352fddecf9699fef80a54f377e9eb3d11d106f35a0d391e76c5b05); the first valid counter is 0.
